class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description: Contains the results from YAML parsing or emitting operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/emitted data or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document] or [method get_data] with an index parameter.

method.name: error
method.description: Creates an error result with the specified error message and optional line and column information.

method.name: get_data
method.description:
Returns the result data. For multi-document YAML, specify an index to access a specific document. Returns [code]null[/code] for error results or if the index is out of range. For single-document results, [code]index[/code] parameter can be omitted. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Parse a multi-document YAML string var yaml_string = """ # First document title: Document 1 --- # Second document title: Document 2 """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if !result.has_error(): var first_doc = result.get_data(0) var second_doc = result.get_data(1) print(first_doc.title) # Output: Document 1 [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_document
method.description: Alias for [method get_data] for semantic clarity. Returns a specific document from multi-document YAML results. Returns [code]null[/code] for error results or if the index is out of range.

method.name: get_document_count
method.description: Returns the number of documents in the result. Returns [code]0[/code] for error cases, [code]1[/code] for single document results, and the document count for multi-document results.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the error column number if any. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the error line number if any. Returns [code]-1[/code] if not applicable or if there is no error.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the error message if any. Returns an empty string if there is no error.

method.name: get_style
method.description:
Returns the style information if any. Returns [code]null[/code] if no style information is available. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [code]detect_style[/code] parameter of [method YAML.parse]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Parse with style detection enabled var yaml_string = """ list: - item1 nested: {key1: value1} # Flow style multiline: | # Literal style This is a multiline string """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string, true) # Enable style detection if !result.has_error() && result.has_style(): var data = result.get_data() var style = result.get_style()
# Modify data while preserving style data.list.append("item2")
# Re-emit with preserved style var output = YAML.stringify(data, style).get_data() [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: has_error
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains an error.

method.name: has_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the result contains style information. Style information is only available if style detection was enabled during parsing using the [code]detect_style[/code] parameter of [method YAML.parse].

method.name: success
method.description: Creates a success result with the specified data and optional style information.
